newsitem.title: USA: NY precious metals called to open mixed, PGMs off.
newsitem.headline: NY precious metals called to open mixed, PGMs off.

text.p: COMEX and NYMEX precious metals futures were called to open mixed Tuesday, though platinum group metals (PGMs) were seen lower for a second day.

In overnight news, a Russian Finance Ministry official said Russia's metal export agency, Almaz, should receive a Foreign Trade Ministry licence this week to enable it to resume PGM exports which have been suspended for five months.
Reports Monday suggested the Finance Ministry had held up the licence while it reviewed the Almaz contracts.
NYMEX July platinum was seen opening down $2.00 to $3.00 an ounce from Monday's close at $451.10.
NYMEX September palladium was also seen opening down $2.00 to $3.00 an ounce from the previous close at $174.90.
COMEX August gold was called to open unchanged to down 20 cents an ounce from Monday's close at $346.30.
COMEX warehouse gold stocks were down 7,807 ounces at 967,026 ounces Monday.
In the bullion market, spot gold was quoted $343.85/35, compared to the London Tuesday morning fix at $344.00 and the New York close around $344.00/50.
In other news, Russian Prime Minister Chubais said presidential decrees allowing the liberalization of the Russian gold market would be signed soon.
COMEX July silver was seen opening unchanged to up 0.50 cents from the previous close at $4.740.
COMEX silver stocks fell just two ounces to 203,982,355 ounces Monday.
